shellCommands.command: cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/SKILL.md && ls -R .agents | head -50 && cat AGENTS.md && ls && cat package.json 2>/dev/null; git ls-files

cat src/App.tsx src/main.tsx; ls __agent_eval__; head -40 .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md; rg -n -i "dialog|modal" .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md | head; .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit Dialog Button ThemeProvider Text
sed -n 165,185p .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md; cat __agent_eval__/run.mjs | head -60; bash .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit Dialog Button Text
ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/; cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md | head -150; npm view @gravity-ui/components version peerDependencies 2>&1 | tail -20
npm view @gravity-ui/components@4 peerDependencies --json 2>&1 | tail -15; npm view @gravity-ui/components versions --json | tail -8
for v in 4.20.0 4.21.0 4.22.0 4.23.0 4.23.1 4.24.0 4.24.1; do echo "$v $(npm view @gravity-ui/components@$v peerDependencies.@gravity-ui/uikit)"; done

npm install @gravity-ui/components@4.23.1 --save-exact 2>&1 | tail -5; node -p "require('./node_modules/@gravity-ui/components/package.json').version"; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/components/; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/components/build 2>/dev/null | head
P=node_modules/@gravity-ui/components; ls $P/build/docs 2>/dev/null; rg -n -i -A12 "required setup|install" $P/README.md | head -50; find $P/build/esm -path "*ConfirmDialog*" -name "*.d.ts"

P=node_modules/@gravity-ui/components; wc -l $P/README.md; cat $P/README.md; cat $P/build/esm/components/ConfirmDialog/ConfirmDialog.d.ts; head -5 $P/build/esm/components/ConfirmDialog/ConfirmDialog.js; rg -n "Footer|Props" $P/../uikit/build/esm/components/Dialog/DialogFooter/DialogFooter.d.ts | head -30
